title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag - Funny Last-Place Punishment
description:
Product overview:
This double-sided flag is an unmistakable fantasy football loser label in a green scoreboard treatment — designed to make the league loser wear or display their failure at a draft party, watch party, home, office, or end-of-season event.

Printed copy on the flag (exact):
Eyebrow: OFFICIAL LEAGUE RESULT
Main lines: FANTASY FOOTBALL
LOSER
Footer: LAST PLACE AND PROUD

Verified product facts:
- Double-sided print (same design printed on both sides).
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor display.
- Printed to order.
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are not included.

Production & listing transparency:
This listing and the layout were created with AI-assisted copy and design work. Production and printing are handled by our trusted print partner, a vetted small print shop that prints each flag to order.

Who this is for:
Adults in fantasy-football leagues buying a bold, good-natured punishment/gag — perfect for draft day, toilet bowl ceremonies, end-of-season parties, or a league roast. The flag is intentionally humorous and competitive: a mock-official eyebrow with a self-aware confession of last-place status.

Notes:
No flagpole or mounting hardware is included. Because each flag is printed to order, production begins after you place your order. If you have questions about materials or size, message me before ordering.
